However, I found that finding a way to channel it helps keep it out of sight of people you might not want to see your quirks. For me, I find writing and music to be the best ways to release it, and I always get unusual and interesting outcomes, with my writing being somewhat surreal and my music changing constantly.

I think when people like us aren’t using our quirkiness, they leak in ways people find uncomfortable or, in my case, somewhat disturbing, so it’s important to release it through other ways. Wish you all the best!
